name: Interval
summary: A sculpted hourglass gives the app a calm, confident identity built around the passage of time.
why: An open upper chamber and a warm lower form meet across a deliberate pause. The hourglass expresses daily rhythm and the value of making time for prayer. Broad curved edges keep the familiar symbol quiet and substantial.
risk: Time is immediate, while the specifically Islamic purpose comes from the app name.
reasonToChoose: Prayer times and daily rhythm should lead.
